metadata.title: Fix hardcoded OAuth callback URL in edit server screen
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

Fixes #3285

---

## 📌 Summary
OAuth callback URL was hardcoded to `http://localhost:4444/oauth/callback` instead of depending on request's `base_url`.

Fixed it dependent on base_url.
